name: jetson_orin_v2
description: Experimental SimX-first v2: two cores, four compute slices per core, 64-byte instruction fills and 32-byte data sectors. The requested DRAM module is 64 GB; the existing RV32 address-space contract is retained.

sources.core: User-defined v2: 8 warps per slice, 32 threads per warp, 32-bit INT and FP register files totaling 64 KiB per slice; one collector with two 1024-bit 1R1W banks.
sources.cache: User-defined v2: private 128 KiB instruction caches with 64-byte lines/fills; private 160 KiB data caches with 128-byte lines, 32-byte sectors, five ways and two banks; 32 KiB shared memory with 32 banks per core.
sources.chip: User-defined v2: one cluster, one socket, two cores, four compute slices per core; L2 bypass and shared 4 MiB L3 with 128-byte lines and 32-byte sectors.
sources.platform: 400 MHz Vortex default. LPDDR5-6400: sixteen x16 channels provide a 256-bit interface and 204.8 GB/s theoretical peak. Ramulator's native LPDDR5_6400 preset supplies uncalibrated device timings; full 64 GB addressing is deferred.
sources.scope: SimX experiment; corresponding RTL changes and timing parity are deferred by user instruction. CTA slot count follows the existing warp-slot implementation. DSM enables masking, without an invented cycle speedup.
